name: Weber Workshops EG-1
details: Single-dose electric grinder with 80 mm flat burrs and a stepless adjustment. Settings count from the burr lock position, which differs per grinder: find yours, then add the chart number.

grindRanges.scale: numbers above the burr lock position (0 = burrs touching)

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 0.8–4.4, espresso 3.6–7.6, moka pot 7.2–13.2, AeroPress 6.4–19.2, V60 8–14, filter coffee machine 6–18, French press 13.8–26, cold brew 16–28. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
